name: QR Code
description: A QR code for every page: a button to show and download it, [qr-code] to place it on a page, and in the corner of printed pages. Made on your server.

panels.title: QR codes
panels.description: QR codes that lead to your pages, for menus, flyers, posters and printed recipes. Type [qr-code] on a page to place one there. Changes show on your pages right away.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Make QR codes
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: button
fields.title: Show a QR code button on every page
fields.description: Visitors can show the code to someone else, or download it.

fields.name: print
fields.title: Print the code in the corner of every page
fields.description: A printed page then leads back to the page online.

fields.name: site-address
fields.title: Site address
fields.description: For example https://example.com. Leave empty to use the address your site is published at, once it has a domain.

fields.name: track
fields.title: Add ?ref=qr to the address
fields.description: So you can see in your analytics how many visitors came from a scan.

fields.name: colour
fields.title: Colour of the code
fields.description: Keep it dark: phones read dark codes on a light background best.

fields.name: language
fields.title: Language
fields.description: For the button and the window that shows the code.

fields.name: skip-pages
fields.title: No button or print code on these pages
fields.description: Page addresses separated by commas, for example: home, checkout. A * at the end means every page under it. [qr-code] still works there.
